verdict.rationale: Drata's own docs show it ships a trust center. One page covers managing the trust center programmatically to accelerate security reviews, another covers SafeBase Trust Center branding and URL setup (implying a hosted page), and a third covers a Trust Center Analytics Dashboard. The evidence is only titles and taglines, though, and none of the specific story elements are documented. Missing for 10: live control status display, certification and report sharing, click-through NDA gating, detail beyond page titles, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I get a hosted public trust center — live control status, certifications, and reports shared under click-through NDA — that closes security reviews before they start

citations.quote: Accelerate security reviews and trust assurance. Automate questionnaires and manage your trust center programmatically.
